data.title: Revoked Medicare Providers and Suppliers Data Dictionary

fields.name: ENRLMT_ID
fields.label: Enrollment ID
fields.description: An enrollment ID is a unique 15-digit alphanumeric identifier that is assigned to each new provider enrollment application. All enrollment-level information (e.g. enrollment type, enrollment state, provider specialty and reassignment of benefits) is linked through the enrollment ID.

fields.name: NPI
fields.label: National Provider Identifier
fields.description: An NPI is a unique 10-digit numeric identifier that all providers must obtain before enrolling in Medicare. It is assigned to health care providers upon application through the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES).

fields.name: MULTIPLE_NPI_FLAG
fields.label: Multiple NPI Flag
fields.description: A flag that indicates whether the provider has more than 1 NPI (Y/N). If yes, additional NPIs are displayed in the Additional NPIs file.

fields.name: PROVIDER_TYPE_DESC
fields.label: Provider Specialty Description
fields.description: Specialty description for enrollment’s primary specialty.

fields.name: REVOCATION_RSN
fields.label: Revocation Reason
fields.description: Revocation reason text. If multiple reasons, concatenated with semi-colon.
